description: Document structure template for engage-lexicon proposal generation (Step 7). Decision-focused narrative under a declared jurisdiction; the educational-only disclaimer is ALWAYS stamped at the top (#202 AC7) — no detection heuristic, mandatory on every output.

sections.heading: ## Educational-Only Output — Not Licensed Legal Advice
sections.content: ALWAYS stamped at the top of every engage-lexicon proposal (#202 AC7). The contract for this skill is unconditional disclaimer — no heuristic detection, no opt-out. Renders the standard disclaimer template from SKILL.md → 'Disclaimer template (Educational-Only)' section verbatim, with {date} and {jurisdiction} filled. The disclaimer is the FIRST section, above any metadata or other content.

sections.heading: > ⚠️ **Evidence-fabrication risk detected** on one or more advocates.
sections.content: Banner renders ONLY when fabricationRisk=true — set when an advocate returned zero-fetch evidence twice and was tagged evidence-fabrication-risk by the Return-side validation. Renders immediately below the disclaimer and above metadata. Names the affected advocate(s) and notes the judge's confidenceRationale acknowledgement.

fields.label: Verdict
fields.format: endorse | reject | revise (survey: synthesis-recommended | further-research-required | synthesis-deferred)

fields.label: Degradation Flags
fields.format: comma-separated list; empty when none. Includes authorityHierarchyOverlap, statutoryRecencyStale flags.

sections.heading: ## Claim
sections.content: The full directional legal claim statement extracted in Step 1 (or, in survey mode, the restated landscape question). Anchored to {jurisdiction}.

sections.heading: ## Jurisdiction
sections.content: The declared jurisdiction with a one-line description of why it is the controlling forum (e.g., 'US-DE-Chancery — controller-transaction claims under Delaware corporate law are heard in the Court of Chancery'). Forum-shopping cases note alternative jurisdictions the claim might also be brought in but is NOT brought in here.

sections.heading: ## Research Plan
sections.content: Authority anchors (specific statutes, regulations, leading cases, agency guidance), source classes, recency window, freshness class, authority preferences, fetch budget. Reflects Step 0 output.

sections.heading: ## Baseline
sections.content: The primary agent's one-paragraph initial read with its single grounding controlling-authority citation. Establishes the reference point against which the adversaries are measured.

subsections.heading: ### Core Position
subsections.content: One-to-two-sentence core position from the for-advocate (or survey perspective 1).

subsections.heading: ### Citations
subsections.content: Table: index | title | url | authorityType | authorityWeight | jurisdiction | courtLevel | year | pinCite | one-line excerpt. Full citation entries conform to citation-schema.json.

subsections.heading: ### Analysis Summary
subsections.content: Step-by-step analysis with inline citation-index references. 3–8 bullets.

subsections.heading: ### For-Recommendation
subsections.content: What the for-advocate's analysis supports under {jurisdiction}, framed in the educational-only register (not as legal advice).

subsections.heading: ### Core Position
subsections.content: One-to-two-sentence counter-case from the against-advocate (or perspectives 2/3 in survey mode).

subsections.heading: ### Citations
subsections.content: Table: same columns as for-brief. ZERO URL overlap with for-brief citations (mechanically enforced). If citationOverlap='unresolved' or authorityHierarchyOverlap='unresolved' was tagged, include the warning note here.

subsections.heading: ### Targeted Citation
subsections.content: If targetedCitationIndex is non-null, name the for-advocate citation this case directly rebuts. Otherwise: 'General counter-case; no single for-citation targeted.'

subsections.heading: ### Authority-Hierarchy Conflict
subsections.content: If authorityHierarchyConflict is non-null, name the specific point of hierarchy conflict and the conflictType (higher-authority | same-authority-different-holding | later-amendment | withdrawn-or-superseded | out-of-jurisdiction-controlling-elsewhere | split-of-authority). Otherwise omit this subsection.

subsections.heading: ### Analysis Summary
subsections.content: Step-by-step analysis with inline citation-index references.

subsections.heading: ### Against-Recommendation
subsections.content: What the against-advocate's analysis supports under {jurisdiction}, framed in the educational-only register.

subsections.heading: ### Weakening Evidence
subsections.content: Either the named against-citation (index + excerpt + authorityWeight + authorityType) that most weakened the for-case, OR 'None' with justification. The controlling-vs-persuasive distinction on the cited authority is REQUIRED — missing distinction blocks proposal generation (#202 AC6).

subsections.heading: ### Verdict
subsections.content: endorse | reject | revise (or survey-mode equivalents). If revise, state the revised claim under {jurisdiction}.

subsections.heading: ### Flip Conditions
subsections.content: What evidence would flip the verdict (or reject the revised claim) under {jurisdiction}.

subsections.heading: ### Confidence
subsections.content: high | medium | low, with one-line rationale. When perAdvocateFabricationRisk has any true flag, the rationale MUST acknowledge it. When statutoryRecencyStale is on a material citation, the rationale MUST acknowledge it.

subsections.heading: ### Controlling Authorities Referenced
subsections.content: Optional table of every authority the judge relied on, each annotated with authorityWeight (controlling/persuasive) and authorityType. Renders when controllingAuthoritiesReferenced is non-empty.

subsections.heading: ### Degradation Flags
subsections.content: List of degradation warnings surfaced in earlier steps (citationOverlap='unresolved', authorityHierarchyOverlap='unresolved', degradationEvidence='unverified', statutoryRecencyStale, statutoryRecencyUnverified, recency-gate warnings, evidence-fabrication-risk). Empty when none.

sections.heading: ## Round History
sections.condition: present when rounds > 1 (either judge demanded round-two OR --round-two flag was set)
sections.content: Summary of the round-two for-brief (core position + new citations + how it addressed the targetedCitationIndex and/or authorityHierarchyConflict) and the judge's second pass verdict.

sections.heading: ## Statutory Recency Findings
sections.condition: present when any cited statute, regulation, or agency-guidance authority was checked by the Step 6 recency gate
sections.content: Per-citation report on statutory/regulatory recency. Columns: citation index | authority | year cited | most-recent-amendment-date (or 'unverified') | recency status (current | statutoryRecencyStale | statutoryRecencyUnverified) | judge's materiality assessment (material | immaterial | not-assessed). Material amendments flagged in the table feed into the judge's confidenceRationale.
